# TinyZKP

TinyZKP provides proof receipts for AI agents, APIs, backend workflows, and state transitions.

## Primary Pages

- [Agents](https://tinyzkp.com/agents): how AI agents attach verifiable receipts to tool calls and workflow checkpoints.
- [Agent Platforms](https://tinyzkp.com/agent-platforms): GTM and integration guidance for agent runtimes, IDEs, workflow engines, and marketplaces that want proof receipts as a native capability.
- [Platform Rollout](https://tinyzkp.com/platform-rollout): sales-assisted rollout package for agent platforms, workflow engines, IDEs, and marketplaces; starts from $499/month minimum plus usage after pilot or design review.
- [Verifiable Agent Output](https://tinyzkp.com/verifiable-agent-output): how to turn important agent outputs into structured results with receipt URLs and proof envelopes.
- [Agent Audit Trails](https://tinyzkp.com/agent-audit-trails): how to checkpoint autonomous workflows with receipts auditors and downstream systems can verify.
- [Use Cases](https://tinyzkp.com/use-cases): buyer-oriented hub for agent, API, audit, reserve, portable-verification, and Compute workflows.
- [Compare](https://tinyzkp.com/compare): comparison hub for choosing between proof receipts, signed logs, hash chains, and self-hosted prover infrastructure.
- [MCP Server](https://tinyzkp.com/mcp): install TinyZKP proof tools in Claude, Cursor, and agent runtimes.
- [Integrations](https://tinyzkp.com/integrations): catalog for MCP, REST, SDKs, CLI, browser verifier, badges, and Compute adoption paths.
- [Claude Code MCP Integration](https://tinyzkp.com/integrations/claude-code): install TinyZKP proof tools in Claude Code and return receipts from state-changing agent workflows.
- [Cursor MCP Integration](https://tinyzkp.com/integrations/cursor): configure TinyZKP in Cursor for agentic coding workflows that need verifiable receipts.
- [OpenAI Agent Workflow Integration](https://tinyzkp.com/integrations/openai-agents): use TinyZKP behind OpenAI-powered backend tools so structured agent outputs include receipt URLs and proof boundaries.
- [Proof Templates](https://tinyzkp.com/templates): live self-serve template catalog, parameters, proof claims, and design-review boundaries.
- [Receipts](https://tinyzkp.com/receipts): receipt anatomy, lifecycle, verification paths, and trust boundaries.
- [Recipes](https://tinyzkp.com/recipes): copy-paste patterns for agents, backend APIs, receipt envelopes, and badges.
- [Badge](https://tinyzkp.com/badges): Verified by TinyZKP badge assets for receipt links.
- [Try TinyZKP](https://tinyzkp.com/try): generate a live state-transition receipt in the browser.
- [Examples](https://tinyzkp.com/examples): example receipt workflows for agents, APIs, audit checkpoints, reserves, inventory, and long-trace sizing.
- [Agent Proof Policy](https://tinyzkp.com/agent-policy): policy for when agents should mint, attach, verify, skip, or escalate proof receipts.
- [Verify](https://tinyzkp.com/verify): verify a receipt with first-party WASM where compatible or hosted fallback for current production formats.
- [Evaluation Kit](https://tinyzkp.com/evaluation): buyer-ready decision kit for one receipt workflow, ROI drivers, stakeholders, evidence, and go/no-go gates.
- [Fit Finder](https://tinyzkp.com/fit): interactive and machine-readable route finder for choosing Free, Developer, Pro, Scale, Compute, paid pilot, platform rollout, enterprise, or defer.
- [ROI and Business Case](https://tinyzkp.com/roi): finance-ready worksheet for estimating avoided manual review, support, prover operations, TinyZKP spend, and pilot payback.
- [Pricing](https://tinyzkp.com/pricing): plan recommendations, per-proof rates, Compute economics, and buyer guidance.
- [Paid Pilot](https://tinyzkp.com/pilot?source=llms_txt&medium=llm&intent=paid_pilot_checkout): $5,000 production pilot for one scoped proof-receipt workflow; a confirmed human buyer can fund it through Stripe Checkout, and the fee is creditable toward annual or reserved-capacity agreement if converted within 60 days.
- [Enterprise](https://tinyzkp.com/enterprise): reserved-capacity, support, procurement, Compute planning, and custom state-machine review path.
- [Pricing Calculator](https://tinyzkp.com/calculator): estimate proof receipt costs, compare self-serve plans with Compute, and choose a buying path.
- [Limits and Capabilities](https://tinyzkp.com/limits): plan quotas, anonymous playground caps, supported receipt boundaries, and escalation triggers.
- [Pilot Program](https://tinyzkp.com/pilot): structured design-partner path for one production receipt workflow, success metrics, verifier path, and commercial rollout decision.
- [Offline Proof Verification](https://tinyzkp.com/use-cases/offline-proof-verification): verify TinyZKP receipts in a browser or with hosted fallback without trusting the producer API.
- [Post-Quantum STARK Proving](https://tinyzkp.com/use-cases/post-quantum-stark-proving): transparent, hash-based STARK receipt positioning with no trusted setup.
- [Docs](https://tinyzkp.com/docs): API, SDK, CLI, MCP, pricing, and proof-template documentation.
- [Changelog](https://tinyzkp.com/changelog): release notes, compatibility policy, and release identity endpoints for API, MCP, verifier, schemas, pricing, and public metadata.
- [Security Status](https://tinyzkp.com/security): current security posture and explicit product boundaries.
- [OpenAPI](https://tinyzkp.com/openapi.json): machine-readable public API contract for agents and API clients.
- [Discovery JSON](https://tinyzkp.com/discovery.json): canonical machine-readable summary of TinyZKP positioning, routes, pricing paths, trust boundaries, support paths, and metadata endpoints.
- [Agent-readable offers](https://tinyzkp.com/.well-known/tinyzkp-offers.json): plan selection, source-tagged signup URLs, human-confirmation language, checkout safety, spend caps, and data-boundary rules for LLMs and agent buyers.
- [Receipt share contract](https://tinyzkp.com/.well-known/tinyzkp-receipt-share.json): public verifier share-link format, attribution rules, fragment size limits, and receipt data-boundary guidance.
- [Badge embed contract](https://tinyzkp.com/.well-known/tinyzkp-badge.json): Verified by TinyZKP badge asset, source-tagged verifier embed template, and transparent-receipt boundaries.

## Positioning

TinyZKP is best described as "proof receipts for automated work" or "verifiable receipts for agent actions and state transitions." The public self-serve product is a transparent STARK state-transition receipt service. It should not be described as a general zkVM, a generic privacy proof system, or a blanket private-input zero-knowledge service.

## Integration Notes

- Use MCP first for AI agent workflows.
- Use the agent-platform guide when TinyZKP should be exposed as a native capability inside an agent runtime or marketplace.
- Use the platform-rollout package when receipts should become a native platform feature with policy, verifier placement, support expectations, and commercial launch planning.
- Use REST, SDK, or CLI for backend workflows.
- Use Compute for long supported state-transition traces where high-RAM prover infrastructure is the bottleneck.
- Use the $5,000 paid pilot when a serious buyer needs one real receipt workflow, verifier path, and rollout decision before enterprise or platform adoption.
- Use the Fit Finder when a human buyer or agent needs a conservative first-route recommendation from workflow type, verifier, receipt placement, data boundary, trace size, volume, procurement, and current alternative.
- Use the ROI worksheet when a finance, procurement, product, or engineering buyer needs a forwardable business case for proof receipts.
- Do not put secrets, private customer data, or API keys into transparent receipt parameters.
